profile.headline: Level 2 Advisory  at IBM
profile.summary:
Enterprise systems architect with experience in multiple platforms for large-scale ILM and integration projects with expert knowledge in Test Data Management, Data Archiving, and Data Masking.

Specialties: Mainframe (z/OS, OS/390, MVS) integration of CICS and IMS COBOL applications; DB2, Oracle, Sybase, and SQL Server databases; PeopleSoft architecture; enterprise architecture planning; pre-sales systems engineer; web services; data archiving; test data management; data privacy and masking; Optim

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer
positions.description: Provide level 2 support for the IBM Information Security zSecure and ISKLM products

positions.title: Optim SME/Client Advisor
positions.description: Trusted advisor to large customers to enable them to be successful in their implementation of Optim for Test Data Management, Data Privacy for testing environments, Information Life Cycle Governance (ILG), and Archiving and Decommissioning of databases.

positions.title: Client Technical Specialist
positions.description: Responsible for the technical support of the Optim sales team including conferences, technical support for clients, technical presentations and demos, and initial guidance and support for implementation of Optim.

positions.title: EDM Architect
positions.description: I managed the technical sale of Optim to large enterprises.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Involved in pre- and post-sales work focused on mainframe and SOA solutions

positions.title: Senior Enterprise Integration Consultant
positions.description: Enterprise solutions architect primarily focused on integrating ERP and mainframe systems

positions.title: Client/Server Technical Coordinator
positions.description: Enterprise solutions architect primarily focused on evaluation of new technologies, mainframe integration, and ERP implemantation and integration

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Programming and analysis for the entire department; primarily COBOL and TI990 assembler

positions.title: Electronic Intelligence Analyst
positions.description: Responsible for providing analysis of potential and hostile surface-to-air missle threats and assessing R&D efforts of non-communication electronics for SAM threats.  Received Air Force Commendation Medal for efforts at identifying new threats to nation's war making entities.

company.name: United States Air Force/544th ARTW/544th IAS/IAEM
